name: Example: Refactor a Python Project
description: An example plan showing how to use the plan runner.

tasks.title: Analyze project structure
tasks.description: List all Python files, check imports, identify main modules.

tasks.title: Find and fix syntax errors
tasks.description: Run py_compile on all .py files, fix any syntax errors found.

tasks.title: Add type hints
tasks.description: Add type hints to function signatures in the main modules.

tasks.title: Write tests
tasks.description: Create pytest tests for the main functions.

tasks.title: Update documentation
tasks.description: Update README.md with current API and usage examples.
